name: Plate demon
description: a brimstone demon of the Cracked Road: a hunched body of cracked black basalt with molten orange light glowing through every seam, short curved horns of charred stone, small burning ember eyes, a wide jaw with a furnace glow inside, carrying a huge torn-up slab of riveted grey iron road plating in front of it like a shield, peeking over the top

poses.stand: standing hunched, the iron plate held up in front of it with both claws, eyes over the top
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: breathes and shifts its weight in place, its glow pulsing slowly

move.action: trudges forward behind its iron plate, the plate scraping, staying in the same spot in the frame

attack.action: rises up behind its plate and spits two quick glowing rock shards over the top forward to the right

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
